title: Transient hedge + eviction lockout orchestrator (hotfix)
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: During a recent regional degradation window we observed rapid eviction/reinstate cycles for noisy tenants which amplified tail latency and caused cross-region failovers. This PR introduces a transient-hedge allocation and a per-tenant eviction lockout to prevent immediate re-eviction (thrash). It also adds a small orchestrator that coordinates short-lived hedges across regional controllers and a fastpath lockout in the circuit-breaker to reduce flip-flapping for sub-minute SLO violations.

Summary of changes: 1) transient hedge allocator: small, ephemeral capacity pool that can be spun up for a tenant for a configurable TTL (default 2 minutes) to absorb short spikes without triggering full eviction workflows; 2) eviction lockout: when a tenant is evicted, mark a lockout window (configurable, default 90s) preventing automatic re-eviction or immediate re-provisioning churn; 3) orchestrator: lightweight controller that ensures hedges are evenly spread across available nodes/regions and enforces a max-concurrent-hedges setting per-region to avoid cascading resource pressure; 4) circuit fastpath lockout: CB will now enter a short lockout after reopen if reopen occurred within a configured hysteresis window to reduce repeated open/reopen cycles; 5) telemetry + alerts: new metrics (tenant_hedge_allocations, tenant_eviction_lockouts, hedge_conflicts) and dashboards; 6) tests and docs: unit/integration tests for allocator and lockout logic plus runbook entry for on-call.

Why this is safe as a hotfix: changes are additive and guarded by feature flags. Default behavior preserves existing eviction semantics until flags are enabled per-cluster. Hedged capacity is bounded by conservative defaults and can be disabled from the Console.

Checklist: - [x] design doc linked (ENG-7894) - [x] feature-flagged implementation - [x] unit tests for allocator and lockout - [x] integration test exercising cross-region orchestrator decision - [x] dashboard panels added - [x] smoke-tested on staging cluster - [x] canary rollout plan attached

Related artifacts: linear ENG-7894 (transient hedges), ENG-7930 (eviction stabilization). Runbook: docs/runbooks/eviction-stabilization.md (new section).
